newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation slows to 0.3 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation slows to 0.3 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have slowed in the week ended February 24 to 0.3 percent from 0.4 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
If current price trends continue, monthly inflation for the all of February will be 1.5 percent, it said. The monthly inflation rate in January was 2.3 percent.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended Feb 24 Feb 17
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.7 +0.6
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.111 +0.143
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data but estimates the weekly trend based on prices of 37 basic goods and services.
